items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Crashes back to earth in Week 11 loss
items.text:
Tyson caught one of two targets for six yards and added four rushing yards on his only carry in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.

items.title: Travis Etienne: Clear top back against Bears
items.text:
Etienne carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 loss to Chicago.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Scores heady TD in loss
items.text:
Tate brought in two of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Held in check by Chicago
items.text:
Shough completed 25 of 42 passes for 222 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears. He added 34 rushing yards on three carries.

items.title: Josh Downs: Another four catches in win
items.text:
Downs brought in four of five targets for 59 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

items.title: Chris Olave: Tops century mark in Week 11 loss
items.text:
